posts.author: marclou
posts.text:
Congrats, you're the fastest-growing startup of the week on TrustMRR 👏

$4,884 MRR 
+2,253% growth MoM

This guy built a real-time geospatial intelligence platform. It shows flights, satellites, ships, and so many other things on a globe.

It's free, but you can get the Pro plan ($10,99/mo) to unlock cameras, alerts, and, again, so-many-other-things. It's like Palantir for B2C.

→ https://t.co/7GuL7QaTZh
posts.text_zh:
恭喜，你是 TrustMRR 本周增长最快的创业公司 👏

$4,884 MRR
环比增长 +2,253%

这哥们做了一个实时地理空间情报平台。它能在地球仪上显示航班、卫星、船只，以及好多好多别的东西。

免费可用，也可以升级 Pro 计划（$10,99/月）解锁摄像头、提醒，以及——再说一遍——超多别的功能。就像面向 C 端的 Palantir。

→ https://t.co/7GuL7QaTZh
